privacy_policy_subtitle: How your local data and device permissions are handled
privacy_hero_summary: We are committed to protecting your privacy. The app requires no account or sign-in, contains zero ads or analytics SDKs, and keeps your worship data on your device.
privacy_sec1_title: 1. Data Stored Locally on Your Device
privacy_sec1_body:
• No account, name, email, or phone number is collected or required.
• Your preferences (calculation method, Muadhin voice, Quran bookmarks, Daily Wird, Tasbeeh, and Azkar progress) are stored strictly in local device storage and never uploaded to our servers.
• Uninstalling the app or clearing app storage permanently deletes all local data.
privacy_sec2_body:
• Precise or coarse GPS location is processed locally on-device to compute prayer times and Qibla direction.
• Only when you open Nearby Mosques are query coordinates sent to OpenStreetMap public services (Photon, Overpass API, and OSM map tiles) to display surrounding mosques.
• Location permission is optional: you can deny GPS access and select your city manually at any time.
privacy_sec3_body:
• Notifications & Exact Alarms: Used solely to fire Prayer, Pre-Prayer, and Azkar alerts on time.
• Lockscreen Full-Screen Intent (Android 14+): Displays the Adhan or Azkar screen when the device is locked.
• Battery Exemption & Media Playback Service: Ensures Adhan audio completes reliably in the background. The microphone is never accessed.
• Compass Sensor: Used locally in real time for Qibla direction only.
privacy_sec4_body:
• Zero advertising networks, crash-tracking, or behavioral analytics SDKs are embedded in this app.
• Bundled Adhan audio recordings are sourced from islamweb.net and play locally offline.
• Tapping Directions on a mosque launches an external map app (such as Google Maps), which is governed by that service's own privacy policy.
• You can revoke any system permission at any time without losing offline Quran, Tasbeeh, or Azkar features.
privacy_sec5_body: You retain full control over permissions and local app storage. For any privacy questions or Google Play data inquiries, contact the developer directly:
